title: Tuyết rơi
about: Round x3 of the dark ambient style (khong-gian), as the user asked for many more versions ("tôi rất thích các phiên bản bạn tạo, hãy tạo thêm cho tôi nhiều phiên bản khác"): snow falling at night: soft high glass and a few water-drop notes like flakes, a thin pad held high, no deep bass at all; quiet and cold. A minor at 52 bpm, its F and C. An original piece.
